title: Billy Madison
tagline: Back to school, back to lunch.
about: A rich man-child has to repeat grades one to twelve in six months to inherit his father's hotel empire.
cue: Serve the snacks when Billy starts first grade.

    StartersGrade one ham and cheese pinwheelsTortilla rolls with ham, cheddar, spinach and mustard cream cheeseHow to make it150g cream cheese1 tbsp American mustard4 large flour tortillas8 slices of leg ham60g baby spinach120g cheddar, grated250g cherry tomatoes8 cornichonsMix the cream cheese and mustard until smooth, then spread thinly over the tortillas right to the edges.Layer ham, spinach and grated cheddar over each tortilla.Roll up tightly and wrap in cling film.Chill so the rolls hold their shape.Trim the ends, cut each roll into pinwheels and serve with cherry tomatoes and cornichons.Madison Hotel mini club sandwichesTriple-decker toast with chicken, bacon, lettuce and tomatoHow to make it6 rashers of bacon12 slices of white bread4 tbsp mayonnaise200g sliced cooked chicken1 small iceberg lettuce2 tomatoes, sliced1 bag salted potato crispsGrill the bacon until crisp.Toast the bread and spread with mayonnaise.Build each sandwich with toast, chicken, lettuce and tomato, then toast, bacon and lettuce, then the last slice of toast.Press down gently, pin with toothpicks, trim the crusts and cut into squares. Serve with crisps.Prawn cocktail, Marie Rose sauceBilly's poolside order, before O'Doyle rules.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsPool party chilli cheese dogsHot dogs under spiced beef chilli and melted cheeseHow to make it300g beef mince1 onion, diced1 onion, finely diced, to serve1 tsp ground cumin1 tsp smoked paprika1/2 tsp chilli powder200g tomato passata8 frankfurts8 hot dog buns120g cheddar, gratedAmerican mustard, to serveBrown the mince with the diced onion, then add the cumin, smoked paprika, chilli powder, passata and a splash of water.Simmer until thick.Grill the frankfurts, turning, and toast the split buns.Fill the buns with frankfurts and chilli, top with cheddar and grill until melted.Finish with raw diced onion and a squeeze of mustard.Grade three crispy chicken tendersHoney mustard to dip.
